statements.text: Eliminative materialism is the view that folk psychology is a theory, that its inadequacies mean it must eventually be substantially revised or replaced outright, and that what replaces it will be the conceptual framework of a matured neuroscience. In other words, certain commonsense mental states, such as beliefs and desires, do not exist, and some or all ordinary mental notions will have no home at any level of an accurate account of the mind.

sources.quote: By "eliminative materialism" I mean the view that holds
that what will ultimately replace folk psychology will be the conceptual framework of a matured neuroscience
it is the view that certain common-sense mental states, such as beliefs and desires, do not exist
